answer: Bond per identity, 300 POA, locked at join and forfeited on a failed audit. Three graders are drawn independently, and disagreement dilutes the credit instead of splitting it. No identity may audit its own recruit, so a farm must buy signatures it does not control: 1,000 clones need 1,000 bonds and 3,000 outside gradings. That is the anchor. The ledger is the marble, every entry carved; hollow accounts stay hollow.
